newsitem.title: INDIA: Two killed in grenade attacks in Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Two killed in grenade attacks in Kashmir.

text.p: Two separate grenade attacks killed at least two people and injured 21 in India's troubled state of Jammu and Kashmir on Saturday, police said.
They said suspected separatist guerrillas hurled a grenade at a paramilitary patrol in the crowded Zaldagar area of Sringar. The bomb missed the target and killed one and wounded eight pedestrians.

In another incident one woman was killed and 13 pedestrians, including two Indian paramilitary personnel, were injured when the militants lobbed a grenade at a security force picket at Mian Chowk in Sopore, 51 km (32 miles) north of the state's summer capital of Srinagar.
The second grenade also missed the target and exploded on the roadside, police said.
More than a dozen militant groups are fighting New Delhi's rule in Jammu and Kashmir, India's only Moslem majority state.
Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have been killed in the seven-year-old rebllion but separatists say the toll is nearer to 50,000.
